headword: {印鑑証明|いんかんしょうめい}

definitions.gloss: certificate of seal registration, seal certificate
definitions.explanation: An official document issued by a municipal office that certifies a registered personal seal ({実印|じついん}). Required for major legal and financial transactions in Japan.

examples.japanese: {印鑑証明|いんかんしょうめい}を{取|と}る。
examples.english: To obtain a seal registration certificate.

examples.japanese: {不動産|ふどうさん}の{契約|けいやく}に{印鑑証明|いんかんしょうめい}が{必要|ひつよう}です。
examples.english: A seal registration certificate is required for real estate contracts.

examples.japanese: {印鑑証明|いんかんしょうめい}の{有効期限|ゆうこうきげん}は{発行|はっこう}から{三|さん}か{月|げつ}のことが{多|おお}い。
examples.english: Seal registration certificates are often valid for three months from the date of issue.

notes:
COMPONENTS: {印鑑|いんかん} (seal/stamp) + {証明|しょうめい} (certification/proof). Full formal name: {印鑑登録証明書|いんかんとうろくしょうめいしょ}.

Needed for major transactions:
- {不動産|ふどうさん}{売買|ばいばい} — real estate purchase
- {車|くるま}の{購入|こうにゅう} — car purchase
- {遺産|いさん}{相続|そうぞく} — inheritance
- {会社|かいしゃ}{設立|せつりつ} — company establishment

RELATED WORDS:
- {実印|じついん} — registered personal seal
- {印鑑登録|いんかんとうろく} — seal registration (the act of registering)
- {認印|みとめいん} — unofficial seal (for everyday use)
